name: Etools
description: A small collection of utilities and plugins for developers and site builders.

suggests.entity_reference_revisions: Required only if you use the etools_err_subset field formatter; ERRSubsetFormatter extends EntityReferenceRevisionsEntityFormatter.

project_description: A small collection of utilities and plugins for developers and site builders: an entity helper service, two Twig functions wrapping it, and four field formatters (entity-reference subset display, entity label linked to a URL with the entity id as a query parameter, and string text linked via a companion link field).
